train_one_epoch_run: run one epoch of training a PyTorch model with mixed precision and gradient clipping
train_one_epoch_with_mixup: train one epoch using mixup augmentation and model EMA updates on a PyTorch model
train_one_epoch_with_distillation: train one epoch using a DistillationLoss criterion and loss scaler for AMP training
evaluate_model: evaluate a PyTorch model on a data loader and return accuracy and loss metrics
evaluate_model_with_metrics: evaluate a model and log top-1 and top-5 accuracy with cross entropy loss
